english.note: Use this when the permission is someone’s agreement or consent, especially in everyday speech.
This is the all-purpose noun for agreement, assent, or consent.
This is the all-purpose noun for consent or agreement, especially in everyday situations.
This is the all-purpose choice for someone’s voluntary agreement or permission.
Use 同意 as the all-purpose noun for agreement or consent.
Use this when “blessing” means a person's permission or approval rather than a religious blessing.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for general approval, rather than for the physical gesture or official authorization.
Use this as the ordinary noun for agreeing to a proposal or arrangement.
Use this for permission or consent when someone agrees to let something happen.

examples.english: I still haven't got my family's permission, so I don't dare sign up.
examples.traditional: 我仲未攞到屋企人嘅同意，唔敢報名。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 mei6 lo2 dou2 uk1 kei2 jan4 ge3 tung4 ji3 m4 gam2 bou3 meng2

examples.traditional: 呢個安排得到大家同意。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 on1 paai4 dak1 dou2 daai6 gaa1 tung4 ji3

examples.english: I've got your approval, so we can start.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 lo2 dou2 nei5 ge3 tung4 ji3 zau6 ho2 ji5 hoi1 ci2 laa3
